# Every base read as a run

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`worlds-are-runs` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](worlds-are-runs.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A world is exactly a run of the law its webs and exchanges show, and every run on webs and exchanges is a world; a world balances exactly where that run follows the law of exchange, as each does with the rest counted; a feasible course of a law of exchange and the carried amount are such runs.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A world's web at a step (standings, activity, requirements, needs and drawing) is a configuration, and its relata's exchange a move. Every world is a run of the law it shows, every run on webs and exchanges is a world, and each reading returns the other exactly; the law a run's world shows lies within the run's law; a world's web is its run read through its dependences. (`Becoming.WebAt`, `Becoming.WebAt.dependence`, `Becoming.World.webAt`, `Becoming.World.law`, `Becoming.World.run`, `Becoming.Run.world`, `Becoming.World.run_world`, `Becoming.Run.world_webAt`, `Becoming.Run.world_move`, `Becoming.Run.world_run`, `Becoming.Run.world_law_le`, `Becoming.World.web_along`)
2. The law of exchange on webs relates two webs by an exchange in which each relatum's standing after it, with what is taken from it, is its standing before with what is given to it; the relations of dependence may change in any way. A world balances exactly where its run is a run of this law, exactly where the law it shows lies within it, and exactly where some run of it has the world's webs and exchanges. (`Becoming.exchangeAt`, `Becoming.World.balanced_iff_run`, `Becoming.World.balanced_iff_law`, `Becoming.World.balanced_iff_exists_run`)
3. Every run of the law of exchange on webs is a balanced world, and a balanced world is a run of it, with the standings of the world's run of exchange; read across and back, each returns itself. With the rest counted, every world's whole web, not only its standings, is a run of the law of exchange, with no premise, carrying the world's standings, requirements and needs. (`Becoming.Run.world_balanced`, `Becoming.World.balancedRun`, `Becoming.World.balancedRun_level`, `Becoming.World.balancedRun_world`, `Becoming.World.restRun`, `Becoming.World.restRun_web`)
4. The course a law of exchange generates, formations and conditions read as roles of one relatum, is a world standing at the generated levels; under a law of what has stood it balances exactly where the course is feasible, so a feasible course is a run of the law of exchange. Its generation, a determined process of stage and history, has one run from the start, the generated history, off which its standings are read. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.courseWorld`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.courseWorld_level`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.courseWorld_balanced_iff`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.courseRun`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.courseRun_state`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.generation`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.generation_runs`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.courseWorld_generation`)
5. The carried amount is the standing of the world the carrying law generates, every formation active and nothing required; that world balances with no premise, so the carried amount is the standing of a run of the law of exchange. (`Becoming.carriedWorld`, `Becoming.carriedWorld_level`, `Becoming.carriedWorld_balanced`, `Becoming.carriedRun`, `Becoming.carriedRun_level`)
6. Cited from their own results: the orbit of a determined law is the run of its process, and every run of that process is the orbit from its start; readings in context are a world along every run. (`Becoming.Law.run`, `Becoming.Branching.law_run_state`, `Becoming.Contextual.world`)
7. One course, two readings: a law of exchange generates one course, its flow and its web at the generated levels (ExchangeLaw.courseWeb), and over one kind of relatum the one-kind world (World.ofKind) and the two-role world, formations and conditions as roles of one relatum (World.ofRoles), are by definition readings of that one flow and web (world_eq, courseWorld_eq). For every flow and web of one kind, the two-role world's conditions stand where the relata stand, its formations take and give what the relata take and give, and the two balance together with no premise; so for every course, and where the course is feasible they give one run of exchange. (`Becoming.World.ofKind`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.courseWeb`, `Becoming.CourseRoles.world_eq`, `Becoming.CourseRoles.courseWorld_eq`, `Becoming.World.roles_level`, `Becoming.World.roles_take`, `Becoming.World.roles_give`, `Becoming.World.kind_balanced_iff_roles`, `Becoming.CourseRoles.level_eq`, `Becoming.CourseRoles.take_eq`, `Becoming.CourseRoles.give_eq`, `Becoming.CourseRoles.balanced_iff`, `Becoming.CourseRoles.runs_agree`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. A law of what has stood (Nonanticipating) and the course's feasibility are written in as hypotheses only where a course is read as a balanced world; the carrying law's strengths and gaps are supplied as in its own result; the shared index of steps and the natural-number amounts are commitments of the representation.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That a world is a run by definition: worlds are still defined without processes, and the two readings are one by exact correspondence in both directions. Witness: `Becoming.World.run_world`.
- That every process is the law of some world: a process's configurations need not be webs, and reading a run's claims as a world keeps neither moves nor standings. Witness: `Becoming.Frame.world`.
- That every world balances: balance is a condition on a world, given with every world only once the rest is counted; likewise that the readings glue. Witness: `Becoming.World.balanced_iff_run`.
- That the two course worlds are one term: their relata differ (R and R ⊕ R), so they are two readings of one flow and one web, defined once (ExchangeLaw.courseWeb); they stand at the same levels, exchange alike, balance together with no premise and give one run of exchange (Becoming.CourseRoles). Witness: `Becoming.CourseRoles.courseWorld_eq`.
- That the correspondence goes beyond unfolding: run_world, world_webAt, world_move and balanced_iff_run are rfl or Iff.rfl; the checked content is balanced_iff_exists_run, courseWorld_balanced_iff, generation_runs and carriedWorld_balanced. Witness: `Becoming.World.run_world`.
- That the process and world families are one by definition: they meet through correspondence theorems, and at landing 1,019 of 7,214 spine theorems were still apart by dependency (a measurement, not a theorem).

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren, 12 October 2026: “let's go back to main track, yes, i do agree with your reading, there are no two realities”. This result answers the integration finding of the release-readiness review: the spine had two roots, Process and World, joined by correspondence theorems, with the frontier stated on coupling arrays. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): the root is the run because every other reading is one; a run is the unfolding read step by step, what it is at each step and how it goes on, and a world is the same unfolding read as relata of one kind exchanging; the identification is exact, so the two are one reading of one unfolding, not two things joined, and the run is no ground beneath the world. What a world adds to its run is nothing; what the law of exchange adds is the relation of standing and exchange that balance states, as a law of the run's steps.
